item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Danish medister sausage with brown gravy, potatoes and cabbage salad. Served with pickled cucumber and lingonberries on the side.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Taiwanese San Bei Ji, three cup chicken, with jasmine rice and sautéed bok choy. Served with chilli sauce and a crisp Asian cucumber salad. GREEN DISH: Dish Taiwanese San Bei Ji with tofu, jasmine rice and sautéed bok choy. Served with chilli sauce and a crisp Asian cucumber salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Paella with shellfish, squid, blue mussels, parsley and lemon. (3+5+10+14+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Paella with chickpeas, courgette, red bell pepper, parsley and lemon. (10+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Ramen with pork neck in an intense chicken, pork, miso and soy broth, with finely shredded cabbage, spring onion, chilli and sesame. (1+7+8+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Ramen in an intense vegetable broth with miso and soy, with soy-marinated egg, shredded cabbage, spring onion, chilli and sesame. (1+2+7+8+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Pasta alla Norcina, creamy pasta with Italian sausage-spiced turkey, white wine and garlic, topped with grated parmesan and chopped parsley. Served with chilli sauce and grilled courgette salad. Also available gluten-free.
